messages.subject: Clarification
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to see the spatial effect of my data with the following code:
> Spatial<-Analysis$summary.random$NAME_1a
> Spatiala<-Analysis$summary.random$NAME_1b
> tot<-Spatial$"0.5quant"+Spatiala$"0.5quant"
But it brought out this warning:
Warning message: In Spatial$"0.5quant" + Spatiala$"0.5quant" :
  longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length

Initially, I thought it was my data not matching up with my shapefile, so I recoded my data but still getting this warning message. Please, what is the issue and how do I fix it?

Thanks for your help.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Clarification
parts:
yes, they seems to be vectors of different length. you have to look into
the model definition, or a simplified version of it, to find the source
for this.

H
